name: DL3DV_BENCHMARK_EVENT
description:
DL3DV_BENCHMARK_EVENT Dataset
	

This dataset contains data for benchmarking deep learning in 3D vision. Due to the large file size, the data has been split into multiple parts for uploading.

	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset provides complete data for the DL3DV benchmark, including a 49-frame image sequence and related 3D vision information. The dataset is suitable for various 3D vision research tasks such as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), 3D reconstruction, novel view… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Falcary/DL3DV_BENCHMARK_EVENT.
general_score_metric: PSNR (primary for novel-view synthesis), supplemented by SSIM/LPIPS/Chamfer distance for quality/geometry
typical_sota_score: PSNR ~25–35 dB (scene-dependent); SSIM ~0.80–0.98; Chamfer distance varies by dataset
reputation: A technical 3D-vision benchmark used by niche research groups for NeRF and reconstruction evaluation; adoption is growing but not yet widespread.
